name: Tempered Steel
description: A finely heat-treated steel stock built for elite edges and balanced resilience.
specialEffects: Used in knightly swords, premium arms, and precision-forged armor parts.

steps: Refine raw stock for Tempered Steel under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Refinement Station protocol before storage.
